subject: Workday supplier invite redirects to wrong tenant — org name encoding
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Trouble accepting Workday supplier invite

Hi Sofia,

We received the Workday supplier invite this morning but when our procurement lead clicks the Accept link it jumps to a different Workday tenant that shows an empty company record — no fields prefilled. We tried twice from different browsers. The URL appears to include an org parameter with our name, but it looks like non-ASCII characters got normalized (our legal name has an ampersand and accented characters in the DBA string).

I attached a screenshot of the redirect and a copy of the W-9 we were planning to upload. Can you confirm the invite target tenant and whether there are tenant alias normalization rules on your side? If we can't get the invite accepted today our first PO will be delayed.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
Borealis Manufacturing

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Workday supplier invite

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick note and attachments.

We're looking into this now. A few quick clarifying Qs that will help speed investigation:
- Which browser/os did you test (Chrome/Edge/Firefox, mobile/desktop)?
- Can you paste the full redirect URL (or the query parameters) from the screenshot?
- Did the redirect show a login prompt for a different company name, or a generic "No supplier found" page?

Ben — can you check whether our Workday invite generator normalizes tenant/org names by stripping punctuation or mapping non-ascii chars? Sometimes Workday tenancy lookup will match on a canonical slug and that can collide if two vendors have similar slugs.

Monica — if this is tenant aliasing we should be able to reissue a targeted invite that pins the tenant_id param. If needed I can request a temporary invite token.

Liam — once we confirm, I'll reissue and share a short checklist for the Borealis team to follow.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Onboarding (Procurement Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Workday supplier invite

Hi Sofia,

Thanks — we tested on:
- Chrome 110 on Windows 10 (primary)
- Safari on macOS (secondary)

Redirect URL (copied from browser bar):
https://workday.example.com/supplier/signup?org=Borealis%20Manufacturing%20%26%20Co&invite=abc123

The page that loads shows the heading: "No supplier record found for this tenant" and a small footer that reads "Tenant: borealis-manufacturing". That last part looks like a slugified version where the ampersand became a hyphen and accented letters removed. Our official Workday tenant is "borealis-manu-ø" in their system (we're migrating names) — so I suspect the invite landed on a legacy slug that points to a different tenant.

Let me know what you find. If you can reissue an invite that pins tenant_id or accepts the exact tenant slug, that would be great.

Appreciate the quick help.

— Liam
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealis.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Workday supplier invite

Liam / Sofia — quick update from our side after triage with Workday support (case WD-553211):
- Root cause: invite URL used our display-based org slug which is run through a normalization step (strip punctuation, replace non-ASCII) before Workday resolves tenant. That produced a collision with a stale tenant alias.
- Short-term fix: I issued a new invite that includes the explicit tenant_id parameter (not the org slug). That link expires in 48 hours. New invite link: https://workday.example.com/supplier/signup?tenant_id=tenant-78421&invite=def456

Next steps for Borealis: open the link in an incognito window (to avoid cached cookies) and follow the checklist: 1) choose "Create new supplier account" 2) upload the W-9 (we received yours in the attachment) 3) confirm bank details after account created.

Monica — can you open JIRA-OPS-1347 and add a note to update our invite generator to prefer tenant_id when tenant metadata exists? I'll follow up with Engineering to prioritize — this will prevent future collisions for vendors with punctuation/diacritics.

Liam — please confirm when you have accepted the new invite and I will fast-track the PO approval.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
